name: Nesco American Harvest Snackmaster Express Dehydrator & Jerky Maker
description: Includes 4 drying trays 2 fruit roll sheets and 2 spices500-watt dehydrator with adjustable thermostatVita-Save exterior blocks harmful UV lightPatented drying system for fast even drying with no tray rotation. Make delicious healthy. dried snacks in a snap with the Nesco American Harvest Snackmaster Express Dehydrator and Jerky Maker. This convenient unit features a 500-watt dehydrator with an adjustable thermostat (from 95 to 155 degrees F). Dry foods in hours with this powerful system which operates via the patented Converga-Flow system. Converga-Flow forces air down the pressurized chamber that surrounds the food trays rather than through the trays themselves resulting in fast more nutritious drying. No tray rotation needed! Exterior light which destroys the nutrition in dried food is blocked by the opaque exterior of this unit. A top-mounted fan prevents dripping of liquids into the heating chamber. This dehydrator comes complete with four food trays as well as a fruit roll sheet and two packs of original spices. Measures 9.75W x 13.5D x 13.5H inches. Compatible with Add-A-Tray accessories (sold separately). About NescoThe Nesco Roaster first appeared on the scene in the early 1930s in Milwaukee Wisconsin. Nesco (the National Enamel and Stamping Company) was a well-known maker of pots and pans and other kitchen items but the roaster was one of their first forays into electric appliances. History was made. The roaster quickly spread throughout Wisconsin farms and became an extremely popular accessory in rural kitchens. Now produced by the Metal Ware Corporation of Two Rivers Wisconsin the Nesco Roaster has entered our homes as one of the most versatile dependable and useful appliances we own. Nesco continues to produce their famous roaster complete with new technological advances like convection air fans and non-stick coatings. There's nothing like an American classic - FD-60.
